quotes.text: allowing the diagnostic agents to order tests and immediately observe their consequences
and computing precision, recall, and F1-score to measure recommendation quality

parsed.rationale: Examination recommendations are simulated clinical orders, so the item applies. Simulation of results is disclosed and unneeded orders lower precision, F1 and a turn-based reward. The paper does not say which actions write or are irreversible, and the simulation status is not in the agent prompt.
